reminder.owner_since_run: [akmon] learning: {{sessions}} and {{days}} since the last learning run — run the `learning` skill to review them.
reminder.owner_since_start: [akmon] learning: {{sessions}} and {{days}} since akmon began counting (no learning run is recorded yet) — run the `learning` skill to review them.
reminder.model_since_run: [akmon] Learning reminder: {{sessions}} and {{days}} have passed since the last learning run. In your first reply to the owner, tell them once that a learning run is due and that they can start it with the `learning` skill; do not start it yourself.
reminder.model_since_start: [akmon] Learning reminder: {{sessions}} and {{days}} have passed since akmon began counting, and no learning run is recorded yet. In your first reply to the owner, tell them once that a learning run is due and that they can start it with the `learning` skill; do not start it yourself.

cli.usage:
usage: akmon learn status | sessions [--all] | mark [--at TIME]   (each takes [--project-root PATH])
  status         sessions and days since the last learning run, and the reminder thresholds
  sessions       this project's recorded sessions (Claude transcripts, Codex sessions) modified since the last run
                 (before the first run: since counting began); the first line is the listing time
                 --all  list every recorded session, whatever the record says
  mark           record the end of a learning run: last_run = now, the counted sessions cleared
                 --at TIME  stamp that UTC time (the listing time of `sessions`, e.g. 2026-10-28T09:30:00Z) instead of now
cli.status_not_counting: counting since: no session recorded yet
cli.status_days: days since the last run (or since counting began): {{days}}
cli.status_days_none: days since the last run (or since counting began): -
cli.status_thresholds: reminder at {{sessions}} sessions or {{days}} days (from <dev root>/.akmon.toml [learning])
cli.sessions_none: akmon learn: no sessions of this project since {{since}}
cli.sessions_none_ever: akmon learn: no sessions of this project found
cli.sessions_listed_at: akmon learn: listed at {{listed_at}} (pass it as `akmon learn mark --at {{listed_at}}`)
cli.marked: akmon learn: learning run recorded at {{last_run}}; the counted sessions are cleared
